title: HybridModulePlan
description: Validates the modulePlan array emitted by the Contract Agent in FRESH mode. Consumed by hybrid-router.js before dispatching to execution-router.js.

trigger.description: When the module runs. Only build-time is supported in P0/P1.

input.description: Human-readable description of what the module receives as input.

output.description: Human-readable description of what the module contributes to the contract.
